value.notes: Three BUSINESS days for issuance of a building permit or other nondiscretionary authorization for an application that meets the City checklist, under Palm Springs Municipal Code section 8.100.060(B). See eligibility_constraints for the small residential rooftop pathway scope. This is the stated permit-review/issuance rule, not an end-to-end installation, inspection or utility permission-to-operate turnaround; incomplete applications require correction and resubmission.

timeline_days.notes: Explicit City code issuance deadline for checklist-compliant applications only; no minimum, calendar-day conversion or general processing-time estimate is supplied.

value.program_or_pathway: Palm Springs Municipal Code Chapter 8.100 — expedited small residential rooftop solar permitting
other_conditions: The application must meet the City checklist requirements to qualify for the three-business-day issuance rule.
The system must meet applicable state and City fire, structural, electrical and other building codes and state health and safety standards.
The panel or module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height as defined by the City.
Incomplete applications receive a written correction notice for resubmission; a use permit may be required on a documented finding of a specific adverse public-health or safety impact.

eligibility_constraints.notes: Scope of the Chapter 8.100 expedited pathway only; this is not a general limit on all solar installations in Palm Springs.

permit_fees.notes: No current adopted solar fee verified.

value.name: Self-Generation Incentive Program — Residential Solar and Storage Equity, solar component (waitlisted)
value.description: The state-funded Residential Solar and Storage Equity program includes a solar incentive paired with energy storage for qualifying low-income households. CPUC assigns Desert Community Energy customers to SCE. SCE reports that RSSE funds are exhausted and applications are waitlisted; the SGIP tracker also lists SCE AB 209 Non-POU as Waitlist. This is not a standalone solar rebate or a separate award from the paired storage program.
value.eligibility: Income-qualified residential customers; solar must be paired with eligible energy storage. Individual eligibility, program requirements and a funding reservation must be confirmed with the assigned program administrator.

rebates.notes: Solar component of the same paired RSSE program identified in battery_programs. The current tracker lists Waitlist; inclusion does not establish an available funding reservation. The schema has no waitlisted status; no dollar amount or award date is asserted.
